اعتنقن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَقْنَ (iʕtanaqna) /iʕ.ta.naq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اُعْتُنِقْنَ (uʕtuniqna) /uʕ.tu.niq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اِعْتَنِقْنَ (iʕtaniqna) /iʕ.ta.niq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
